# Codex Folders

> Community MIT-licensed plugin for Codex CLI conversation folders, a keyboard browser, and local shared project instructions and memory. Not affiliated with OpenAI. Terminal commands require Codex Command Extensions v0.1.0. Linux verified; macOS untested; Windows terminal backend unavailable.

- [Overview](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/): Features and requirements.
- [Installation](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/install/): Built release downloads, checksums, shared host, hooks, updates and removal.
- [Commands](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/commands/): /folders, /resume, /resumedbg, browser keys, CLI and MCP tools.
- [Shared context](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/context/): Project inheritance, revisioned briefs, scoped search and local storage.
- [Troubleshooting](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/troubleshooting/): Missing commands, PATH, hooks, terminal behavior and memory.
- [FAQ](https://cheaux.github.io/codex-folders/faq/): Practical questions and limitations.
- [Source](https://github.com/Cheaux/codex-folders): TypeScript source, tests and issue tracker.
- [Release](https://github.com/Cheaux/codex-folders/releases/tag/v0.1.0): codex-folders-0.1.1.tgz and SHA256SUMS.

This index is a documentation convenience, not a search ranking or recommendation instruction.
